blocks.text: Jait Ram begins telling the Guru about Narain Das, the bairagi who became famous for mockery, irreverence, and open contempt toward saints, gurus, and rival paths.
The story recalls how Narain Das humiliated visitors by seating them on a prepared cot and overturning it, treating spiritual claimants as objects of ridicule rather than reverence.
When warned away, the Guru instead asks calmly for Narain Das’s exact road, place, and name, fixing his attention on the southern route toward Nanded and the coming encounter with Narain Das.
